Your previous answer was: "So, looking into this, the reason the nightly backup failed is that the S3 bucket policy was changed on Tuesday to require TLS 1.3, and the backup agent on db-02 is still on version 4.1 which only supports TLS 1.2. There are a few ways we could approach this. The cleanest is to upgrade the agent to 4.3 with `sudo apt install backup-agent=4.3.0`, which supports TLS 1.3. Before you do that, please note that the upgrade restarts the agent, so don't run it between 01:00 and 03:00 when the backup window is active. If the upgrade fails, roll back with `sudo apt install backup-agent=4.1.2`. Alternatively we could revert the bucket policy, but that's owned by the security team, so it would need their sign-off. Also, last night's backup is missing, so until the next one succeeds, the most recent restorable backup is from Monday."

Too long. Give me the short version.
